title: One input in, a deterministic list of outputs out
subtitle: A single-threaded state machine with no callbacks or virtual calls in the hot path

steps.name: MatchingEngine
details: IdMap from order id to pool slot
Two book sides, each a vector<Level> from worst to best

Order pool plus a free list
